summary: End-to-end verification of MongoDB-migrated Rekap Bon Toko Pinoh app. Backend: 44/44 pytest tests pass (auth roles, PT/Toko/Periode/Nota CRUD, dashboard, pelunasan+files, WA prepare, WA template, audit, backup CRUD, force-delete cascade). Frontend: login works, dashboard shows active periode 'Periode September 2026' with per-PT breakdown (MAL, MSB) and totals, all pages (Rekap, Pelunasan, Toko, PT, Periode, Users, Audit, Backup) render seeded/migrated data correctly, backup create/list works with new .json filename. No integration/serialization issues observed (no MongoDB _id leaks in responses).

issues: Header subtitle still says 'Salinan database SQLite. Bisa diunduh dan dihapus kapan saja.' but backend was migrated to MongoDB — copy should be updated (e.g., 'Salinan database MongoDB (JSON snapshot).')

action_items: (Cosmetic) Update Backup page subtitle in /app/frontend/src/pages/Backup.jsx from 'Salinan database SQLite' to reflect MongoDB/JSON snapshot terminology.

(Optional) The seed data currently reflects prior test runs (10 nota, Rp 1.384.333) rather than the pristine 'total_nominal 110000' documented in test_credentials.md — this is expected given regression tests were executed against the same DB. Consider re-seeding for a demo baseline if needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1100 lines and mixes auth/CRUD/pelunasan/WA/backup — could be split into routers per module for maintainability.

Backup path validation only rejects '..' and '/' — no extension whitelist. Combined with delete_one by name from DB, this is safe against filesystem traversal (nothing hits disk), but consider validating name format for defense in depth.
seed_defaults() runs on import (module level). Fine given idempotent inserts, but ideally moved into @app.on_event('startup') for testability.
get_wa_template appears in the code before its use inside prepare_whatsapp at line 716 — Python resolves it at call-time so it works, but declaration order is confusing.
get_current_user has an env-based admin fallback (uid=1) when DB user missing — reasonable safety net but may mask deleted users. Acceptable for this MVP.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (aligned backup filename assertions from .db to .json; hardened seed_ids fixture to tolerate parallel-worker duplicate toko)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + all 8 tabs render, backup create works)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data required. Tests use TEST_-prefixed transient data; some TEST_ notas remain in active periode from prior iterations (inflating dashboard totals from 1 to 10 nota / Rp 1.384.333). Not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run with: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest tests/backend_test.py --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml (pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; do NOT pass extra -n). The seed_ids fixture is race-safe. All backend endpoints under /api are working with pymongo. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env and stores JWT in localStorage 'rbtp_token'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. The one minor cosmetic issue (Backup page still references 'SQLite') is a leftover string from the pre-migration codebase; main agent can update the subtitle text in /app/frontend/src/pages/Backup.jsx.
